subject: english
question:
Choose the option that is the correct passive form of the sentence.

She ate the last slice of pizza.

options.text: She had eaten the last slice of pizza.
The last slice of pizza had been eaten by her.
The last slice of pizza was eaten by her.
The last slice was being eaten by her.

solution:
The correct answer is** ****'The last slice of pizza was eaten by her.'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the active sentence, "She ate the last slice of pizza," **the subject** "she" is **performing the action** of eating the pizza.
 
• To **convert** this sentence into the **passive voice**, we **need to make** the object of the active sentence ("the last slice of pizza") the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The verb **"ate" **needs to be changed to its corresponding passive form.
 
• In **option 3**, "The last slice of pizza was eaten by her,"** the subjec**t of the passive sentence is "The last slice of pizza," and the **verb** is "was eaten."
 
• The** past participle form **of the verb "eat" is "eaten," which is used in the passive voice.
 
• Grammatically, in the passive voice, the subject receives the action rather than performing it. The **structure of the passive voice **is "be + past participle (verb) + by + agent (optional)."

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'The last slice of pizza was eaten by her.'*
